paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
suggested_experiment_name: Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center Axion Search
notes: Neutron-star magnetosphere axion-photon conversion search using Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center C-band data. Mass range stated as 15-35 ueV in abstract, but analysis covers 4-8 GHz corresponding to ~15-33 ueV; the abstract quotes g_agamma ~ 1e-11 GeV^-1 for masses 15-35 ueV. The actual limit curve (Fig. 1) is not numerically tabulated in the provided text; only the ~1e-11 GeV^-1 level is quoted. Data points given are approximate horizontal representation of the stated bound across the quoted mass range (15-35 ueV = 6.2e-5 to 1.45e-4 eV). Local DM density normalized to 0.346 GeV/cm^3 (NFW profile). 95% CL power-constrained limits. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 40)) | Vision: Traced the fiducial (red) median limit from Fig. 1. Excluded region above the boundary. The red line has narrow spikes (up to 1e-10) at several masses which represent RFI/line features; I traced the smooth lower envelope. Rising toward higher masses. KSVZ/DFSZ shown as reference lines near 5e-15 to 1e-14. | Calibration: No calibration needed (benchmark KSVZ raw_ratio=1.37 snapped to identity)
